decision.summary: Observe and design canonical direct dispatch
alternatives: Flip authority_verified to true: rejected, caller values are not canonical authority.
Implement a bounded canonical dispatch path with explicit truthful capability scope: selected.
Open every advertised operation: rejected while several executors are stubs.
counterevidence: Current worker is healthy and deliberately fails closed; no current unsafe dispatch observed.
Intent source/chat fields alone are payload claims, not cryptographic authentication.
assumptions: Local Unix account and current admitted ingress remain the cooperative trust boundary; no multi-user IAM claim.
decision.forecast: Canonical positive control succeeds for implemented bounded tools; forged authority and unsupported mutations remain refused.
decision.falsifier: Any fabricated success, authority bypass, stale lease execution, or degraded managed runtime
acceptance: Actual AGY implementation and RCA receipt
Canonical positive and stale/wrong-owner/replay negative controls
Independent source review and exact immutable release review
Loaded runtime identity and usable local direct dispatch observed
Truthful pending-items dashboard, branch coverage and main integration
decision.rollback: Preserve current fd4950 source and immutable142d capsule; runtime rollback uses separately reviewed finite grants.
decision.reviewer: Independent Codex reviewer; actual Google AGY is implementation peer.
decision.budget: Pinned local tools, bounded observations, one-hour task leases; no paid model routing or destructive tests.
residuals: Global EV admission and unsupported native subscriptions remain separate pending items.
Durable external response delivery requires separate acceptance; no synthetic Telegram outbound traffic.
